output_list.reason: Integer overflow in buyTokens function allows the buyer to buy tokens, the value of which is determined by the pricePerToken set in the MoxyOnePresale contract. This allows the team to set the balance of the buyer to any value they desire, as long as it is within the total token limit of 50000000. The overflow is not caused by the transfer or approve functions, but by the mint function, which has no effect on the balance of the buyer.
